title: This Frog Breaks Its Own Bones to Grow Claws

scenes.text: This frog breaks its own bones to grow claws.
It's called the hairy frog, and it lives in central Africa.
When a predator grabs it, the frog snaps the tips of its toe bones.
The sharp bone pushes out through the skin, like a claw.
These claws aren't made of keratin like ours. They're real bone, and they heal afterwards.
Breaking its own bones is how this frog fights back.
